Container.Name: Platybill
Container.Overview: Platybill is a private, self-hosted household bill tracker: recurring bills, due-date reminders, a payments ledger and a dashboard.
Container.Description:
Platybill keeps your household bills and due dates in one place, entirely on your own server. It runs as a single Docker container with all data in one SQLite file - no external database, no cloud account.
Features: - Recurring bills: monthly, weekly and every-N schedules, with optional max occurrences and due-date anchoring. - Partial payments ledger: record full or partial payments against each due instance and track what is still owed. - Dashboard: upcoming and overdue bills, monthly spend stats and payment history. - Reminders via Apprise (ntfy, Discord, Telegram, and more) or SMTP email. - Multi-user household accounts with password reset. - Multiple currencies support. - Interface available in English, Polish and German. - Installable as a PWA on desktop and mobile.
Data location: everything lives under /data - the SQLite database, the auto-generated JWT secret (/data/jwt_secret) and pre-upgrade backups. Back up the /data folder and you have backed up everything.
Updates: images are rolling builds from the main branch; the footer of the UI shows the deployed commit. For stability, pin a sha tag from the container registry instead of latest.
Container.DefaultTagDescription: Rolling builds from main (pin a sha tag for stability)
Container.Changes: Rolling commit builds; see the GitHub commit history for changes.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI and API port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, JWT secret and pre-upgrade backups.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as; set it to the owner of the appdata folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as; set it to the group of the appdata folder.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw (TZ database name).

Config.Name: ENVIRONMENT
Config.Description: Runtime environment; leave as production.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set true when served over HTTPS, otherwise browser login will fail.

Config.Name: APP_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public URL used in password-reset emails; replace the placeholder with your server URL or reverse-proxy hostname if needed.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Leave false for direct access. Set true only behind a reverse proxy (SWAG/Caddy/nginx) that appends the real client IP to X-Forwarded-For, so rate limiting keys on the client.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Leave empty to auto-generate and persist in /data/jwt_secret. Set it to keep sessions across reinstalls.

Config.Name: APPRISE_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Apprise API gateway base URL, e.g. http://apprise:8000 (optional).

Config.Name: APPRISE_KEY
Config.Description: Apprise configuration key holding saved notification targets (optional).

Config.Name: APPRISE_URLS
Config.Description: Stateless targets, e.g. ntfy://topic

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: SMTP server for email reminders (optional fallback to Apprise).

Config.Name: SMTP_PORT
Config.Description: SMTP submission port.

Config.Name: SMTP_USER
Config.Description: SMTP username.

Config.Name: SMTP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: SMTP password.

Config.Name: REMINDER_FROM
Config.Description: From address used for reminder emails, e.g. noreply@example.com.

Config.Name: IMPORT_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable automatic bill import from the watch folder. Can also be toggled in Settings.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Local Ollama server for bill extraction, e.g. http://10.112.200.20:11434. Editable in Settings; leave empty to configure there.

Config.Name: OLLAMA_MODEL
Config.Description: Ollama model used for document extraction. Editable in Settings; numind/nuextract3:q4_k_m is a fast alternative.

Config.Name: IMPORT_DIR
Config.Description: Folder polled for bill files (must be inside the data volume). Editable in Settings.

Config.Name: IMPORT_POLL_MINUTES
Config.Description: Minutes between folder scans. Editable in Settings.
